name: UNI
fix_description: Logic flaw in marketAndTIFFs function leading to incorrect accounting.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: it uses a flash loan, swaps through a UniswapV2 pair, repeatedly abuses skim/reserve accounting with the fee-on-transfer token, then swaps back for profit. An experienced auditor could build it without extreme effort, but it requires understanding AMM reserve mechanics and the specific token/pair behavior rather than just spotting a trivial access control bug.
